description: Revisit FF-input unions in a five-trial cross-tensor band
proposal: Family: parameter tying. Current retained frontier is 1,450 parameters at 99.040000%, a +0.040000-point margin. There have been 87 prior macro-attempts and 704 prior micro-trials in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0189/micro-0004 at 1,450/99.04%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0189/micro-0005, while the last FF-input failure was attempt-0178/micro-0002 pair 153/71 at 98.99%. That pair and two earlier sensitive FF-input pairs are excluded. Hypothesis: 46 subsequent cross-tensor reductions reopen FF-input redundancy. The helper adds one ordered eligible union per official micro-trial with runner-only retention/rollback. Stop at first scored discard/error, no pair, five trials, or seven minutes. This is more informative than immediately continuing FF output because it tests the generality of reopening within the final macro budget.
summary: All five FF-input revisit unions qualified, reducing the frontier from 1,450 to 1,445 parameters. No scored discards or errors occurred. Compute used five official migrations/verifications over about 6m10s. Stop reason: predeclared five-trial cap, preserving the final ten macro-attempts for alternating boundary probes.
